companyName: Clearway Operating Solar Portfolio (12 U.S. projects, 50% interest)

result.rationale: Create one manager-level Cardinal Portfolio JV record. SEC, FERC and sponsor evidence establish a March 30, 2026 closed sponsor-equity transaction in which Clearway Energy, Inc. and Fengate-managed vehicles each acquired 50%. The company boundary is the 225-227 MW western operating-solar subset, not the complete Cardinal portfolio or the broader Clearway platform.

evidence.purpose: Current SEC evidence for the Cardinal Portfolio JV name, March 30 close, Clearway's 50% interest and 225 MW scope.
Executed purchase agreement identifying buyers, sellers, target entities and the 50/50 cash membership-interest purchase.
Direct Fengate evidence for its 50% interest, fund attribution, 12-project boundary and 227 MW scale.
Regulatory approval and ownership-chain evidence for the Clearway/Fengate acquisition.
